title: Version 7 Unix /etc/rc
alt: A terminal window running Version 7 Unix. A listing of files dated June 1979 is followed by the command cat /etc/rc, which prints a short startup script: it sets PATH, echoes a licence notice to the console, removes old lock and temporary files with rm -f, mounts a disk, and starts the update and cron programs.
author: Huihermit
description: Version 7 Unix for the PDP-11, running in the SIMH PDP-11 simulator. The contents of "/etc/rc", the startup script run by "/etc/init" at boot time. The script is executed by the Bourne shell.
